title: The Forest Memory Circle

p1_image_1.text:
Welcome to the Forest Memory Circle!

Tonight, the woodland friends are practicing a gentle skill: Memory, and counting. Elder Owl says,
“In this forest, remembering is like holding a lantern. The more carefully you look, the brighter it glows. For each correct answer you make, you will be rewarded with a memory star, collect all ten for a secret ending”

Notice the details in this picture. You’ll be asked about them on the next page.

p2_q1.text:
Question 1 of 10:

Think back to the previous picture.

How many owls were there?

p3_image_2a.text:
Nice job! Your lantern of remembering glows a little brighter.

Take a good look at this picture. You’ll be asked about it on the next page.

You follow the animals along a winding path. On a wooden bench sits a tiny picnic: squirrels wearing little scarves, sharing two acorns beside a leaf-shaped plate.

p3_image_2b.text:
Almost! That one was tricky and that’s okay. 💛
Elder Owl reminds you: “Slow eyes make strong memories.”

Now, look closely at the this picture. You will be asked about it on the following page.

You follow the animals along a winding path. On a wooden bench sits a tiny picnic: squirrels wearing little scarves, sharing two acorns beside a leaf-shaped plate.

p4_q2.text:
Question 2 of 10:

Think back to the previous picture.

How many squirrels were there sitting on the bench?

p5_image_3a.text:
Great job!

Look closely and notice the details. A question is coming on the next page.

The path opens to a secret nook. A stone throne rests among ferns. Above it hang lanterns, glowing like honey.

p5_image_3b.text:
Almost! That one was hard. 

Look closely and notice the details. A question is coming on the next page.

The path opens to a secret nook. A stone throne rests among ferns. Above it hang lanterns, glowing like honey.

p6_q3.text:
Question 3 of 10:

Think back to the previous picture.

How many lanterns were hanging above the throne?

p7_image_4a.text:
Super! 

Study this picture carefully. You’ll answer a question about it very soon.

Near a sleepy stream, you spot a patch of mushrooms: with white spots, lined up beside the water.

p7_image_4b.text:
Tricky that one! You will nail the next one. 

Now, look closely at this picture. You will be asked about it on the following page.

Near a sleepy stream, you spot a patch of mushrooms: with white spots, lined up beside the water.

p8_q4.text:
Question 4 of 10:

Think back to the previous picture.

How many red mushrooms were by the stream?

p9_image_5a.text:
Wonderful!

Take your time and look closely. The next page will ask you about this picture.

A meadow appears, sparkling with dew. Butterflies flutter over the grass, some yellow, some pink, dancing in slow loops.

p9_image_5b.text:
Almost! So close.

Take your time and look closely. The next page will ask you about this picture.

A meadow appears, sparkling with dew. Butterflies flutter over the grass, some yellow, some pink, dancing in slow loops.

p10_q5.text:
Question 5 of 10:

Think back to the previous picture.

How many butterflies were fluttering in the meadow?

p11_image_6a.text:
You are really good at this! 

Look at everything you can see here. You’ll be asked about it on the following page.

The animals host a tiny tea party. On a stump-table sit teacups and a teapot shaped like an acorn.

p11_image_6b.text:
Almost! That one was tricky.

Now, look closely at this picture. You will be asked about it on the following page.

The animals host a tiny tea party. On a stump-table sit teacups and a teapot shaped like an acorn.

p12_q6.text:
Question 6 of 10:

Think back to the previous picture.

How many teacups were on the stump-table?

p13_image_7a.text:
Wonderful!

Pause for a moment and look carefully. A question about this picture comes next.

An old tree has a bookshelf carved into its trunk. You see storybooks lined up neatly, each with a different colored spine.

p13_image_7b.text:
So close! you will get it next time for sure

Now, look closely at this picture. You will be asked about it on the following page.

An old tree has a bookshelf carved into its trunk. You see storybooks lined up neatly, each with a different colored spine.

p14_q7.text:
Question 7 of 10:

Think back to the previous picture.

How many storybooks were on the shelf?

p15_image_8a.text:
Nice job!

Try to remember what you see. The next page will ask you about this picture.

A fox leads you to a berry bush. Hanging from the branches are golden berries that glow softly like tiny lanterns.

p15_image_8b.text:
Nice job!

Pause for a moment and look carefully. A question about this picture comes next.

An old tree has a bookshelf carved into its trunk. You see storybooks lined up neatly, each with a different colored spine.

p16_q8.text:
Question 8 of 10:

Think back to the previous picture.

How many golden berries were on the bush?

p17_image_9a.text:
You are so smart!

Look closely and make a picture in your mind. You’ll answer a question on the next page.

At a shallow pond, flat stones form a path. You count stepping stones making a gentle curve across the water.

p17_image_9b.text:
Almost! So close.

Now, look closely at this picture. You will be asked about it on the following page.

At a shallow pond, flat stones form a path. You count stepping stones making a gentle curve across the water.

p18_q9.text:
Question 9 of 10:

Think back to the previous picture.

How many stepping stones crossed the pond?

p19_image_10a.text:
Super!

Take a careful look at this scene. A question about it is coming up next.

Finally, you reach the ‘Star Map’ clearing. In the sky above the trees, you can spot bright stars clustered close together.

p19_image_10b.text:
That was a tricky one! 

Now, look closely at this picture. You will be asked about it on the following page.

Finally, you reach the ‘Star Map’ clearing. In the sky above the trees, you can spot bright stars clustered close together.

p20_q10.text:
Question 10 of 10:

Think back to the previous picture.

How many bright stars were in the cluster?

p21_result10_a.text:
Wonderful! Good Job

The stars twinkle as if they heard you answer. Elder Owl smiles.“That was the last question. Let’s see which ending your Memory Stars unlock.”

p21_result10_b.text:
Good try!

Elder Owl says, “Even when a star slips away, you still walked the whole path.”

“Let’s see which ending your Memory Stars unlock.”

p22_gate.text:
Elder Owl opens a tiny velvet pouch.

“Each correct answer earned a Memory Star. If you collected all ten, the forest will sing the Perfect Goodnight Song.”
